title: SBI PO Admit Card 2026 Released: Prelims Exam Schedule and Download Instructions
content:
The State Bank of India has officially released the long-awaited Probationary Officer (PO) admit cards for 2026, marking a significant milestone for hundreds of thousands of candidates preparing for one of India's most competitive banking recruitment examinations. Candidates can now download their admit cards from the official SBI portal at ibpsrbi.ibps.in using their registration credentials.

The preliminary examination is scheduled to commence on July 27, 2026, with multiple shifts planned throughout the day to accommodate the large candidate pool. Each candidate has been assigned to a specific examination center based on their location preferences during registration, with the admit card clearly specifying their center code, reporting time, and examination schedule. SBI PO recruitment 2026 represents the most significant hiring drive in recent years, with over 1,000 positions open across various branches nationwide.

The admit card contains critical information that candidates must verify carefully, including their name, registration number, examination date and time, exam center address, and important instructions regarding entry and conduct during the examination. Candidates are advised to download and print their admit cards at least one week before their scheduled examination date to avoid last-minute technical issues.

Entry to the examination hall requires both the admit card and a valid government-issued photo identification document, such as a passport, Aadhar card, driving license, or voter ID. Candidates should report at least 30 minutes before the start time mentioned on their admit card. SBI has emphasized that late arrivals will not be permitted to take the examination under any circumstances.

The prelims examination will test candidates' aptitude in quantitative ability, reasoning, and general awareness through a computer-based test format. Candidates who qualify the preliminary stage will proceed to the main examination, scheduled approximately one month after the prelims results are declared. This two-stage selection process ensures comprehensive evaluation of candidates' banking and financial knowledge.

SBI has implemented strict security measures and updated the examination protocol following previous year feedback. Candidates are prohibited from carrying mobile phones, calculators, or any electronic devices into the examination center. The bank strongly recommends candidates read all instructions on the admit card thoroughly and visit the examination center location beforehand to familiarize themselves with the venue and plan their travel accordingly.

For candidates facing difficulties downloading their admit cards, SBI has activated help desks at major branches and the official website provides detailed troubleshooting guides. The admit card download window remains open until the completion of the preliminary examination phase, allowing candidates flexibility in obtaining their documentation.
